name: astra-advisor
description: Codex-native dynamic orchestration with user-configurable model preferences.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, route, verify, and review work with your preferred models.
interface.longDescription: Astra Advisor preserves the user's selected parent model and effort. The parent keeps decisions and acceptance while a retained squire gathers evidence and coordinates bounded operational work through native Codex subagents. User and AGENTS.md routing preferences precede optional plugin defaults, subject to live tool capabilities. ChatGPT Work cloud tasks remain bounded by the create_thread schema and do not promise arbitrary model or effort pinning.
defaultPrompt: Use $astra-advisor:orchestration to plan, build, verify, and review this work.
Keep decisions and acceptance with the parent; use a retained squire for information acquisition and bounded operational work.
